name: value-columns
title: Value Columns
description: Plain vertical columns comparing magnitudes — value on top, zero-based column, label below — with an accent-highlighted hero column.

meta.question: How do these few values stack up side by side?
meta.whenToUse: Comparing one magnitude across a handful of named entities where side-by-side height reads instantly (tariffs, prices, counters).
meta.antiUse: Not for many items (>8) or time series — use rank bars or lines instead.
